teaser.en: Its flowers look torn in half, with all the petals on one side, as if someone had picked away the rest.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yanaonekana kama yamechanwa nusu, petali zote zikiwa upande mmoja, kana kwamba mtu amezichuma nyingine.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganaonekana dza gakpwanyuka nusu, makodza ga ruwa gosi uphande mwenga, dza kukala mutu wagadola ganjina.

summary.en: Beach naupaka is a low succulent shrub of the beach crest and fore-dune, with fleshy leaves, half-flowers and black berries. It helps to hold the sand of Kenya's beaches in place.
summary.sw: *Beach naupaka* ni kichaka kifupi chenye unyama cha kilele cha ufuo na matuta ya mbele ya mchanga, chenye majani manono, nusu-maua na beri nyeusi. Husaidia kuushikilia mchanga wa fukwe za Kenya mahali pake.
summary.dg: *Beach naupaka* ni chitsaka chifupi cha madzi-madzi cha dzulu ya ufuwo na vidzango vya mtsanga vya mbere, chenye makodza ga nyama, nusu za maruwa na matunda madide maru. Chinaterya kugbwira mtsanga wa maufuwo ga Kenya usitsukulwe.

about.en:
Beach naupaka is a low, spreading shrub with thick, fleshy leaves that resist the salt and sun of the beach. Its flowers are its most striking feature: the petals are all on one side, fanned out in a half-circle, so each flower looks like half a flower.

The flowers are followed by round berries that ripen black, which gives the plant its other English name, inkberry.
about.sw:
*Beach naupaka* ni kichaka kifupi kinachotanda, chenye majani manene na manono yanayostahimili chumvi na jua la ufuoni. Maua yake ndiyo sifa yake inayovutia zaidi: petali zote ziko upande mmoja, zimetandazwa kama nusu duara, hivyo kila ua linaonekana kama nusu ya ua.

Maua hufuatwa na beri za mviringo zinazoiva na kuwa nyeusi, na hilo ndilo linaloupa mmea jina lake lingine la Kiingereza, *inkberry*.
about.dg:
*Beach naupaka* ni chitsaka chifupi chinachoenea, chenye makodza manene ga nyama ganayovumirira munyu na dzuwa ra ufuwoni. Maruwage ndigo chitu cha ajabu zaidi: makodza ga ruwa gosi gamo uphande mwenga, ganaenea dza chiphephero cha nusu ya mviringo, kpwa hivyo chila ruwa rinaonekana dza nusu ya ruwa.

Bada ya maruwa kunatuluka matunda madide ga mviringo ganayoivwa na kukala maru, na ichi ndicho chinachochipha dzina ranjina ra Chingereza, *inkberry*.

where.en: It grows on the fore-dune and beach crest of Kenya's sandy shores, the first band of shrubs above the open sand. Look for it in low mounds along the back of the beach, often with beach morning glory spreading at its feet.
where.sw: Huota kwenye matuta ya mbele ya mchanga na kilele cha ufuo katika fukwe za mchanga za Kenya, safu ya kwanza ya vichaka juu ya mchanga ulio wazi. Utakipata kama vilima vifupi kando ya sehemu ya nyuma ya ufuo, mara nyingi mlakasa ukitanda miguuni pake.
where.dg: Chinamera kpwenye vidzango vya mtsanga vya mbere na dzulu ya ufuwo wa mtsanga wa Kenya, kanda ya kpwandza ya vitsaka dzulu ya mtsanga wazi. Uchihendze dza vidzango vifupi kanda-kanda ya nyuma ya ufuwo, mara nyinji phamwenga na *beach morning glory* unaoenea photsiche.

uses.en: It is valued as a dune stabiliser: its roots and spreading stems hold the sand of the beach crest in place.
uses.sw: Kinathaminiwa kwa kuimarisha matuta ya mchanga: mizizi yake na mashina yake yanayotanda hushikilia mchanga wa kilele cha ufuo mahali pake.
uses.dg: Nkutogolwa kpwa kugbwira vidzango vya mtsanga: miziye na mihiye inayoenea inagbwira mtsanga wa dzulu ya ufuwo usitsukulwe.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet, and no Swahili name either. In English it is beach naupaka or inkberry, and its scientific name is *Scaevola plumieri*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo, wala jina la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza kinaitwa *beach naupaka* au *inkberry*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Scaevola plumieri*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi, na takuna ra Chiswahili piya. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *beach naupaka* au *inkberry*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Scaevola plumieri*.
